newsitem.title: CANADA: NOVA sets C$200 mln preferred share issue.
newsitem.headline: NOVA sets C$200 mln preferred share issue.

text.p: NOVA Corp said on Thursday it would issue eight million fixed/floating rate cumulative redeemable preferred shares, series 1 at C$25 per share.
The offering, expected to be made on March 20, was seen garnering proceeds of C$200 million, NOVA said.

NOVA said the shares would pay an annual fixed dividend of C$1.2875 per share, or 5.15 percent, for an initial five-year period. After the period, holders would be able to choose between fixed or floating rate dividends every five years.
The issue was to be underwritten by an investment dealer group led by RBC Dominion Securities Inc.
NOVA said proceeds from the issue would be used to finance the activities of its international gas services subsidiary.
The company said it would apply to the Toronto and Montreal Stock Exchanges for approval to list the series 1 preferreds.
